Container.Name: Cork
Container.Overview: Cork is a self-hosted pinboard for saving images and ideas into boards. It supports multiple users, drag-to-reorder, public boards, a "Pin to Cork" bookmarklet and saved product prices. Everything is stored in one folder: a SQLite database plus your images.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port for the Cork web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and uploaded images. Back up this folder.

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set to true if Cork is reached through SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, Caddy or similar.

Config.Name: Admin username (first start only)
Config.Description: Optional. Creates this admin account on first start. Leave empty to use the setup page instead.

Config.Name: Admin password (first start only)
Config.Description: Optional. At least 8 characters. Only used when no accounts exist yet.

Config.Name: Max upload size (MB)
Config.Description: Largest image Cork accepts, for uploads and downloads.

Config.Name: Allow fetching from LAN
Config.Description: Let 'save from a website' fetch from private/LAN addresses. Leave off unless you trust every user.
